summary.headline: Geomantic and Astrological Codex Materials
summary.text: Continuation of a Florentine codex catalogue describing geomantic and astrological materials: Bouses the philosopher on figures, Petosiris and Nechepso, diagnostic calculations for illness and life or death, judgments of the laxeuterion, zodiacal verses, diagrams of trigons and tetragons, chronological notes from Adam to Constantine, and a breviary of geomancy. References cite Bandinius, Riess, and related codices.
